scope: operator OIDC adapter route contract with an in-process fake provider
covered: login starts with a cleared transient session and delegates to the configured callback URI
callback accepts only the fake client's state-validated userinfo result and issues opaque session/CSRF cookies
the actual OIDC adapter registers the normalized discovery URL, openid/profile/email scopes, and S256 PKCE configuration
the actual OIDC adapter rejects a wrong issuer, missing/empty subject, or oversized subject before opening the auth database connection
missing userinfo and unprovisioned subjects fail closed without issuing an operator session
session response is no-store and contains only the provider's active scope list
logout requires CSRF, revokes the local session, and a later session request is denied
limitations: The fake Authlib registration check validates configured discovery URL, scopes, and PKCE method, but does not exercise Authlib's protocol implementation, real issuer signatures, token exchange, or provider-specific claims.
No operator identity/session database function, live scope grant, browser, or external callback was exercised.
Real OIDC provider configuration and authenticated candidate acceptance remain open.
